claims.label: Erika Kirk requests public privacy on Charlie Kirk's burial location
claims.claim: Erika Kirk asked the public to allow her family privacy regarding the location where Charlie Kirk is buried, citing the need to protect her children, in-laws, and parents, and announced plans for a "museum style" memorial at Turning Point USA.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify burial location and date through cemetery or estate records; cross-check with Milo Yiannopoulos' claim that Charlie has not yet been buried.

claims.label: Erika Kirk Nehemiah analogy defense of TPUSA staff
claims.claim: Erika Kirk defended Turning Point USA staff from criticism using a Nehemiah wall-building analogy, comparing the situation to Nehemiah being called down from building the wall and stating "my silence does not mean that I am complacent" and "I cannot come down. I am busy building."
claims.investigative_direction: Compile catalog of identified TPUSA staff statements that have been disputed and assess whether Erika's characterization matches the underlying record.

claims.label: Erika Kirk published casket video on Instagram
claims.claim: Erika Kirk published a video on Instagram showing her at Charlie Kirk's casket saying "I love you, I love you, I love you" with another person responding "God bless you."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain archived Instagram post metadata, timestamp, and current status (public, private, deleted); verify any deletion history.

claims.label: Erika Kirk attended Sergio Gor ambassador swearing-in
claims.claim: Erika Kirk appeared at Sergio Gor's swearing-in ceremony as US Ambassador to India, delivering a brief speech in which she stated "Charlie loved you" and "Charlie is going to be with you every single day in spirit."
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference ceremony date with Erika Kirk's public schedule; verify any travel reimbursement or charter flight records.

claims.label: Tucker Carlson confirms Egyptian-registered aircraft followed Erika Kirk
claims.claim: Tucker Carlson, on the Theo Von podcast, stated that Egyptian-registered aircraft had been following Erika Kirk in multiple places around the world for years, and characterized the claim as "factually true."
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference with ADS-B historical data, FAA aircraft registration records, and any NSA/CIA-sourced confirmation previously cited in the series.

claims.label: Tucker Carlson confirms foreign-registered cell phones at Kirk event
claims.claim: Tucker Carlson stated on the Theo Von podcast that the claim of a disproportionately large number of foreign-registered cell phones at the Charlie Kirk event was "true."
claims.investigative_direction: Seek cell tower records or ping data through legal process; identify any carrier records of foreign-registered IMSI devices near the venue.

claims.label: Pre-event X posts predicted Charlie Kirk killing
claims.claim: Tucker Carlson stated that individuals posted on X predicting that Charlie Kirk would be killed on a specific date prior to the assassination, and questioned whether the FBI had interviewed those posters.
claims.investigative_direction: Use archived X searches and Wayback Machine to recover the referenced posts; cross-reference with FBI affidavit exhibits and any disclosed investigative steps.

claims.label: Tucker Carlson expresses lack of confidence in FBI leadership
claims.claim: Tucker Carlson stated he does not have confidence in the FBI or the men who run it, and noted that the FBI has publicly stated it possesses both a confession from the suspect (in his text to his boyfriend) and the murder weapon with his fingerprints.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Tucker's stated concerns with the official FBI affidavit and any public DOJ statements; identify what additional evidence the FBI has declined to disclose.

claims.label: USAF C37A 99-044 flight path September 7-9, 2025
claims.claim: USAF C37A Gulfstream V (tail 99-044), based at Andrews AFB, flew Andrews → Colorado Springs (Sept 7), Colorado Springs → Tucson (Sept 8), with the transponder going dark thereafter, then Fort Huachuca → El Paso at 12:31 PM (Sept 9), and El Paso → Andrews.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference with ADS-B Exchange historical archives, FAA SWIM data, official DoD manifests if obtainable, and Andrews AFB logs.

claims.label: RCH-to-SAM call sign change indicates senior official pickup at Fort Huachuca
claims.claim: The flight's call sign changed from RCH (Reach) to SAM (Special Air Mission) after departing Fort Huachuca, which according to on-air flight analyst Mark indicates that someone of senior executive-branch, cabinet, congressional-delegation, or vice-presidential stature was picked up at Fort Huachuca.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify SAM call sign designation rules against published DoD flight operations manuals; cross-reference historical call sign assignments and known passenger lists.

claims.label: Captain at Fort Huachuca meeting identified as Adam Nef, 10th Mountain Division
claims.claim: The captain who interrogated the Fort Huachuca witness ("Harry") on September 9, 2025, has been positively identified as Adam Nef of the U.S. Army's 10th Mountain Division.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Adam Nef's command assignment through official Army biographies, unit press releases, and any publicly available 10th Mountain Division rosters.

claims.label: JTF operates unmarked SCIF at Fort Huachuca with barbed wire and TS clearance
claims.claim: Joint Task Force at Fort Huachuca operates out of an unmarked building that has been converted to a Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility (SCIF), now surrounded by barbed wire, with cell phones and personal electronics prohibited and top secret clearance required for access.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference with public DoD facility records, news coverage of SCIF construction at Fort Huachuca, and any base expansion announcements.

claims.label: Candlewood Suites security footage preservation requested for September 8, 2025
claims.claim: The host, echoing a comment from "servant of Yahweh," publicly requests preservation of security footage from the Candlewood Suites hotel near Fort Huachuca on September 8, 2025, depicting an individual described as a young woman and another as a "special ops guy" leaving together in a green truck.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the specific Candlewood Suites property, send legal preservation letters, and request hotel guest and vehicle registration records.

claims.label: Pam Bondi previously flew on USAF C37A 99-044
claims.claim: According to the tipster email, Pam Bondi used USAF C37A Gulfstream V (tail 99-044) approximately five months earlier, flying from the Tampa area back to Washington, DC.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference with publicly available Pam Bondi travel records, Tampa-area appearances, and any obtainable DoD flight manifests.

claims.label: Host concurs with critiques that Erika's moral outrage is manufactured for elite audiences and that criticism of Jews is not inherently antisemitic
claims.claim: The host explicitly agrees with Merryill Gerston Meyer's thesis that Erika Kirk's moral outrage is manufactured for an elite target audience rather than grassroots supporters, and with Laughing Cats Music World's thesis that criticism of corrupt Jewish actors is distinct from antisemitism.
claims.investigative_direction: Track pattern of Erika Kirk's public appearances to determine whether audience composition supports or contradicts the elite-audience thesis.
